message.content: This preview shows **mpg** (miles per gallon) alongside engine details like **cyl** (cylinders), **disp** (displacement), **hp** (horsepower), and **drat** (rear axle ratio). Other columns include **wt** (weight), **qsec** (quarter-mile time), and categorical features like **vs** (V vs. straight engine), **am** (automatic transmission), **gear** (number of gears), and **carb** (number of carburetors).
